items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I got up and left and got a job with a Cuban band, Ricco's Creole Band.

ctx.x: So now, all right, I was supposed to go back with Willie Lewis and we was supposed to go to Knokke.
All right, but it seems that at rehearsal that Burns insulted me or something and I got up and left. I got up and left and got a job with a Cuban band, Ricco's Creole Band.
